default.speaker: Ms. Ledger
lines: Mark Agency Accounting Department. State your name, badge number, and regrettable expense.
If this concerns a fake moustache, we already know.

default.speaker: Ms. Ledger
lines: We handle reimbursements, travel costs, and the financial consequences of your detective work.

loan_request.speaker: Detective
lines: I need an emergency advance. For the case.

loan_request.speaker: Ms. Ledger
lines: Is this a real emergency, or did a museum gift shop defeat you again?

loan_approved.speaker: Ms. Ledger
lines: Approved. Seventy-five dollars have been added to your mission budget.
Use it on the case, Detective.
The agency does not reimburse decorative cursed idols.

loan_limit_reached.speaker: Ms. Ledger
lines: You have reached the agency's emergency-loan limit.
Technically, you are now a recurring monthly expense.

loan_cancelled.speaker: Ms. Ledger
lines: Try not to expense anything that explodes.
